notes:
Account background: NimbleCanvas is a B2B product design SaaS used by PM and design teams. Fast-growing, strong developer culture.

Discovery notes (10/02): Interested initially in hosted API for prototypes (chat + embeddings). Asked about per-tenant indexing and vector store best practices.

Demo (10/18): Ran host API demo focusing on streaming chat and function calling. Positive reaction to low-latency streaming; internal architect asked about KV cache persistence.

POC (11/01 - 11/28): POC targeted two workloads: semantic search over product docs (embeddings) and an in-app help assistant (chat). POC used ~450k docs, avg query 120ms target.

Procurement push (11/30): Product team wants Dedicated for predictable throughput and VPC isolation. Legal flagged DPA and MSA redlines. Quote requested for reserved capacity + burst.

Direct quotes from stakeholders: "We cannot have EU user content leave the region for processing; also need audit trail of prompts for 13 months"; "Burst is critical for marketing launches - need clear overage caps."

Key internal contacts: CTO - Elena Marquez, Head of Product - Jonah Liu, Procurement - Dana Rivers.

Observed sentiment: High technical fit; commercial negotiation is the gating factor. Legal risk: medium until DPA/MSA redlines resolved.

requirements_summary: Workloads: semantic search (embeddings) and conversational assistant. Latency targets: 100-150ms p50 for chat, p95 < 450ms during normal traffic. Throughput: sustained 200 qps for search, burst to 1200 qps for campaign bursts. Model preference: open Llama-family variants with quantized runtimes; fallback to smaller variants during overload. Data controls: per-tenant data residency, audit logs, retention to 13 months, KMS integration for keys. Cost sensitivity: mid-market budget, prefers predictable monthly reserved capacity with burst credits.
poc_details: POC dataset: 450k docs (product docs + KB + release notes)
Success metrics: embedding recall >= 85%, chat accuracy measured via 50 evaluation prompts >= 80%
Observations: embedding pipeline stable, KV cache reduces token cost by ~22% in tests
Technical ask: show Dedicated sizing that keeps p95 chat under 450ms at expected peak
legal_status: MSA v3 received from Redwood; NimbleCanvas legal returned redlines 2024-12-01. Main asks: SLA 99.95 uptime, expanded breach notification timeline, explicit EU data residency clause, increased indemnity carve-outs. DPA: add processor-subprocessor list, require SCCs or equivalent, restrict cross-border processing for EU tenant data.
